designed_after_observing: Original final P2 and diagnostic raw plus outside analysis already observed. Followup, not retroactive preregistration.
time_budget_note: 3h target with30min documentation reserve; no adaptive grid expansion.

timing.pass_order: core six permutations across6blocks; width cyclic Latin across3blocks
timing.method_order: all6 or24 permutations, seeded shuffled cycle; full multiples in all main passes

lifecycle.session: before artifact read through final owned-tensor cleanup+sync; IDs H2D included
lifecycle.loop: N real fn+completion synchronize; first call included; output immediately deleted; no events/sample copies
lifecycle.worker_wall: parent spawn to exit, includes import/context/setup/teardown
lifecycle.costs_not_additive: first call part of total_loop; setup and final cleanup part of session; session part of worker wall

memory.owner_rule: stage correlation only unless stack identifies allocation owner; otherwise UNATTRIBUTED
memory.main_latency_shared_residency: not method-isolated memory; never merge with P2 peaks

decision.core: median C/B H block-median ratios<=0.90 and>=5/6 faster -> REPEATABLE_IN_THIS_CORE_TEST candidate
decision.small_difference: median ratio within(0.90,1.10); descriptive not significance or implementation gate
